answer.reason: Both provide HCM software covering payroll and the employee lifecycle to employers and HR teams across industries and company sizes. Their core software-provider models align; Paylocity’s additional Finance and IT offerings do not negate the direct overlap.
answer.missing_evidence: Exact subscription and contract structures are not supplied, but the passages establish sufficient product and customer overlap.

citations.text: Paycom is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) software provider that helps organizations manage payroll and HR in one place. Built on a single database, Paycom automates the employee life cycle — from hiring to payroll to time and labor — while reducing the manual work created by disconnected tools.
